goal:
Build on-demand MCP submission feature: API endpoints + UI panel.

FULL SPEC:

## API Endpoints (add to ui_server.py)

POST /api/submissions
Body: {mcp_name, url, description?, requested_by?, business_purpose?, environment?}
Logic:
  1. NORMALISE: strip whitespace, lowercase mcp_name, normalise URL (remove trailing slash, force https)
  2. DEDUP CHECK: query mcp_submissions WHERE status != 'rejected' AND (lower(mcp_name)=? OR url=?) -- return existing submission if found with status
  3. REGISTRY CHECK: query mcp_server_registry WHERE lower(name)=lower(mcp_name) OR url=? -- if already fully scored, return existing record, do not create submission
  4. CANONICAL CHECK: query mcp_server_registry for fuzzy name match (levenshtein or LIKE '%{name}%') -- surface top 3 candidates as 'did_you_mean' list in response
  5. If clean: INSERT into mcp_submissions (server_id=gen_uuid, mcp_name=normalised, url=normalised, status='pending_dedup_review', submitted_at=now())
  6. INSERT into mesh_events (event_type='mcp_submission', payload=json of submission)
  7. Return: {submission_id, status, queue_position, did_you_mean[], estimated_scoring: 'next_batch_run', message}

GET /api/submissions
Returns all submissions with status. Optional ?status= filter.

GET /api/submissions/{submission_id}
Single submission status + any scored result if complete.

POST /api/submissions/{submission_id}/approve
Moves status from 'pending_dedup_review' to 'queued' -- operator confirms this is not a duplicate.

## Submission Status Flow
pending_dedup_review -> queued -> scoring -> scored | failed
rejected (operator action)

## SLM Batch Queue
Do NOT score live. When status='queued':
  - INSERT into mcp_discovery_candidates (server_id, name, url, source='user_submission', promoted=false)
  - The existing promoter daemons pick it up and run it through the signal pipeline
  - Status updates to 'scoring' when candidate_promoter_daemon picks it up
  - Status updates to 'scored' when server_id appears in mcp_signal_scores

## UI Panel (add to main dashboard)
Add a submission panel accessible via button 'Submit MCP for Assessment' in header.
Panel contains:
  - Form: MCP Name (required), URL (required), Description, Environment (Production/Staging/Dev), Business Purpose
  - On submit: show dedup results and 'did you mean' candidates before confirming
  - Confirmation step before final submission (user must click Confirm after seeing dedup check)
  - Submission queue table: shows all pending/queued/scoring/scored submissions with status badges
  - Polling: auto-refresh submission status every 30s
  - Clear messaging: 'Scoring runs in batches via the SLM pipeline. Results typically available within the next scheduled run.'

## Dedup Rules
- Same URL (normalised) = definite duplicate -> reject with existing record
- Same name (case-insensitive, stripped) = probable duplicate -> surface for review
- Levenshtein distance <3 on name = possible duplicate -> surface as 'did_you_mean'
- Existing registry entry = already assessed -> return current scores, no new submission

## Error States
- Invalid URL format -> 422 with clear message
- Name too short (<3 chars) -> 422
- URL not reachable (optional async check) -> warn but allow submission
- Submission already exists -> 200 with existing submission_id and status
constraints: mcp_submissions table already exists -- do not recreate
Dedup check must run before any INSERT
'did_you_mean' must surface before user confirms submission
success_criteria: POST /api/submissions returns submission_id and did_you_mean list
Duplicate URL returns existing record not new row
